mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply chain disruption regime (INDPRO decline > 2.0% over 3 months), reduced industrial output increases inflation expectations and triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines >2.0% over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% triggers a monetary policy tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher interest rates reduce corporate borrowing and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
